core: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and junction maintenance
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity, podocyte nephrin and cortical microtubules
rationale: Members concern establishing and maintaining epithelial apical-basal and cytoskeletal polarity with adherens junctions; nephrin/podocyte and cortical microtubule members distinguish it from junction-assembly and EMT confusables.

name: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance
rationale: All members cover intestinal lipid uptake and the chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL particle lifecycle, unlike confusables centred on HDL assembly, cholesterol efflux or vitamin E/sterol transport.

name: Neuronal calcium influx with metabotropic glutamate and gap-junction signaling
rationale: Members regulate calcium entry and intercellular neuronal/glial signaling via inhibitory mGluR and electrical gap junctions, whereas confusables emphasize presynaptic inhibition, connexin trafficking or adenylate cyclase regulation.

core: Glandular branching morphogenesis via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
name: Prostate and salivary gland branching via epithelial-mesenchymal signaling
rationale: Members describe reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling driving prostate and salivary gland budding, branching and epithelial differentiation, distinct from genital-tract, lung or pancreatic/kidney confusables.

name: Intrinsic apoptosis execution via BAX/BAK, apoptosome and SMAC
rationale: Members form the downstream mitochondrial apoptosis cascade from BAX/BAK pore formation to cytochrome c/SMAC release and apoptosome caspase activation, lacking the BH3-only and MOMP-regulation steps of the confusables.

name: PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated mitophagy regulation
rationale: Members concern selective autophagy of damaged mitochondria and its restraint, distinguished from pexophagy and mitochondrial dynamics/protein-targeting confusables by PINK1-Parkin and receptor mitophagy.

name: Bile acid enterohepatic transport, secretion and signaling
rationale: Members cover bile acid export, recycling, receptor signaling and feedback control of synthesis, whereas confusables focus on bile acid synthesis routes, lipid ABC transporters or xenobiotic export.

qualifier: PAX3, with ALK and PTEN transcription
name: PAX3 targets plus ALK- and PTEN-linked transcription
rationale: Three members are PAX3 target/motif modules joined by ALK-driven nuclear events and PTEN transcription, which separates it from RUNX3, CDH1, FOXO and BMP-driven transcription confusables.

name: Blood pressure lowering via cGMP, vasodilation and natriuresis
rationale: Members reduce arterial and pulmonary pressure through NO/cGMP signaling, inhibited vasoconstriction and renal sodium/water excretion, unlike renin-angiotensin pressor or smooth-muscle contraction confusables.

name: Proline synthesis and catabolism within L-amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are proline biosynthesis/catabolism plus generic amino acid metabolic terms; proline distinguishes it from glutamate, glycine/glyoxylate and serine confusables.

name: Cardiac gap-junction coupling and negative heart rate/contraction control
rationale: Members regulate electrical coupling via gap junctions, membrane potential, T-tubules and dampening of heart rate and contraction, versus confusables on action-potential phases, SR calcium handling or positive inotropy.

name: Acylglycerol and phosphatidic acid synthesis with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members synthesize PA, MAG, DAG and TAG and hydrolyse lysophospholipids, which separates it from glycerol/fructose, phospholipid synthesis-remodeling and triglyceride lipolysis confusables.

qualifier: CYP and FMO oxidation, methylation, acetylation
name: Xenobiotic and toxin metabolism via CYP, FMO, methylation, acetylation
rationale: Members cover biotransformation of drugs, toxins and plant compounds by oxidative (CYP, FMO) and methyl/acetyl/sulfo conjugation, unlike confusables centred on amino acid conjugation drug ADME or alcohol/aldehyde oxidation.

name: mRNA polyadenylation, translation termination and nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: Members link mRNA cleavage/polyadenylation to translation termination, NMD and non-stop ribosome release, unlike confusables on deadenylation/decapping decay, histone mRNA or splicing.

name: Placental trophoblast and mammary gland development in pregnancy
rationale: Members cover trophoblast/placental labyrinth formation, decidualization and mammary development through lactation and involution, distinct from prostate, genital tract and germ-stem-cell confusables.

name: BCL-2 family-controlled mitochondrial apoptosis through apoptosome activation
rationale: Members span BH3-only activation, BCL-2 family MOMP control, cytochrome c/SMAC release and apoptosome caspase activation, unlike execution-phase, extrinsic/necroptotic, p53-transcriptional or oxidative-stress confusables.

name: Folate, pterin and formate one-carbon metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover folate/tetrahydrofolate interconversion, formate and pterin metabolism and folate transport, separate from nucleotide synthesis and methionine/SAM cycle confusables.

name: Replication- and repair-coupled nucleosome remodeling with ADP-ribosylation control
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly during DNA replication and repair with ADP-ribosylation and deubiquitination regulation, unlike confusables on transcriptional chromatin complexes or DSB repair choice.

core: RNA modification and translation machinery maturation
name: tRNA/rRNA modification, translation fidelity and mitochondrial gene expression
rationale: Members cover tRNA/rRNA/snRNA processing and modification, translation factor modification and fidelity, and mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and translation, unlike confusables on protein methylation, mRNA decay, Pol I/III transcription or telomerase.

core: Protein localization to the cell surface
name: Apical and membrane-raft protein localization to cell surface
rationale: Members regulate delivery of proteins to the plasma membrane, apical surface and rafts with GTPase activation, versus confusables on basolateral secretion, Golgi export/CFTR trafficking or RHO GTPase cycles.

name: Glycolysis regulation by fructose bisphosphates and pentose-phosphate shunt
rationale: Members control glycolytic flux via fructose 1,6- and 2,6-bisphosphate and PPP diversion, unlike confusables on fermentation/lactate, hexokinase or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programs.

name: ADAR editing, PKR restraint and ARE-mediated mRNA stability
rationale: Members combine A-to-I editing that dampens PKR/type I interferon signaling with ARE-binding mRNA stability and translational silencing, distinguishing it from other ARE-decay, antiviral OAS and stress-granule confusables.

name: Selective organelle autophagy and mitochondrial dynamics regulation
rationale: Members span mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and nucleophagy with mitochondrial fission/fusion, membrane potential and protein targeting control, unlike lysosome fusion, mitochondrial import or aggrephagy/CMA confusables.

name: Drug ADME with glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are drug ADME routes and phase II conjugations, distinguished from broader xenobiotic oxidation confusables by amino acid conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate and specific drug ADME.

name: Lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and adipocyte triglyceride storage
rationale: Members regulate lipid droplet formation, fusion and breakdown, lipophagy and triglyceride storage/lipolysis in adipocytes, unlike confusables on glycerolipid synthesis, LXR lipogenesis or fatty acid import.
